_purpose: Per-target scientific readiness: which defining properties of the planetary reference site the Earth data can and cannot express. Authored from the evidence files (data/target_evidence.csv, data/planetary_measurements.csv) and the Earth data sources, NOT from model output. status vocabulary: measured | proxy | not_measured | not_reproducible_on_earth. screening_scope vocabulary: full_environmental_screen | partial_environmental_assessment | climate_terrain_similarity_only. No target currently qualifies for full_environmental_screen.
_rule_requires_exposed_surface: Targets defined by exposed ground (regolith, bedrock, sediments, dunes, evaporites, buried ice under regolith) require a verified surface-exposure value (D3). A cell whose surface is snow/ice/water covered has no D3 value and therefore cannot be matched to them (an ice sheet is not exposed regolith). Written on 2026-11-16 from physical reasoning before looking at validation results; excluded cells are counted in n_cells_excluded_unverified and shown only in the provisional view.
_d4_note: D4 is treated as a proxy: Earth cells give relief within about 280 km averaged at 1 km, whereas the planetary rules describe metre-scale slope on smooth plains. scripts/d4_analysis.py shows that for flat-terrain targets known analog sites have LOWER D4 similarity than their controls (scale mismatch, not a validation-score argument). Weight left unchanged pending a scale-appropriate terrain metric (for example flat-area fraction from the 1 km DEM).

defining_properties.property: perpetual shadow and cryogenic floor temperature (as low as 25 K)
defining_properties.note: Earth air temperature (POWER T2M) is a cold-climate stand-in only; no Earth surface is this cold.
MODIS snow-cover climatology; not glacier, permafrost or subsurface ice.
relief at about 1 km, not floor slope at the metre scale

MOON_PSR.summary: Cold, dry, ice-proxy regions only. The shadowed-floor environment cannot be reproduced; results indicate cold dry ground, not PSR analogs.

defining_properties.property: near-continuous illumination (about 240 sunlit days per year at the rim)
defining_properties.note: Earth seasonal insolation swing; strongly correlated with cold (rho 0.97), so it adds little independent information.
air temperature, not surface temperature
relief at about 1 km

MOON_SP_RIDGE.summary: Polar exposed-ground regions with strong seasonal light and cold. Lunar illumination geometry is not reproduced.

defining_properties.property: subsurface basaltic cavity (lava tube) behind a collapse pit
defining_properties.note: No dataset in the model sees subsurface voids; pits and tubes are 10-100 m scale on a 280 km grid.
ASTER silicate-contrast proxy, defined in only about 13% of cells; not validated as a basalt indicator.

defining_properties.property: stable thermal environment inside the tube
defining_properties.note: surface swing, not inside-tube temperature

MOON_LAVATUBE.summary: Matches dry, barren, thermally varying ground only. A high score is NOT evidence of lava tubes or basalt.

defining_properties.note: ASTER silicate contrast is not an FeO/basalt measurement and shows a negative rank correlation with the target score in this grid.

defining_properties.property: smooth terrain (median mare slope about 3.5 degrees at 15 m baseline)
defining_properties.note: 1 km relief cannot represent a 15 m baseline slope

defining_properties.property: large day-night swing (about 400 K / below 100 K at the equator)
defining_properties.note: Earth deserts reach a fraction of this swing

MOON_MARE.summary: Flat, dry, barren, large-swing ground. Basalt composition and regolith are not measured.

defining_properties.property: ice buried within a few metres under regolith on flat plains
defining_properties.note: MODIS snow cover only; subsurface ice is not measured. Glacier/ice-sheet cells are excluded by the exposed-surface requirement.
air temperature
relief at about 1 km

MARS_ICE.summary: Cold, dry, exposed polar-desert ground with seasonal snow proxy; ground ice is not verified.

defining_properties.property: ancient delta and lake sediments with clays and carbonates
defining_properties.note: No lithology or mineral map is integrated (GLiM not integrated).
POWER precipitation and MODIS NDVI
about 1 km

MARS_JEZERO.summary: Dry barren exposed ground of intermediate relief. Delta and sediment geology are not evaluated.

defining_properties.property: fluid-driven sedimentary mounds in a thick sedimentary basin (origin still debated)
defining_properties.note: All active rules are climate, surface cover and terrain. The only Earth reference named in the verified source is Azerbaijan, picked for geology, not climate.
about 1 km relief
POWER and MODIS

critical_missing: mound counts and sizes for the Mars reference
MARS_MUDVOLC.summary: Cold, dry, flat, barren ground only. Mud-volcano geology is not evaluated, so results are climate/terrain similarity, not geological confirmation.

defining_properties.property: evaporite salt deposits, 1-25 km2 each, in the southern highlands
defining_properties.note: Deposits are about four orders of magnitude smaller than a 2.5 degree cell; no evaporite layer is integrated.
POWER precipitation

MARS_CHLORIDE.summary: Dry barren exposed ground only; salt deposits are below grid resolution and not mapped.

defining_properties.note: No sand or dune layer is integrated.
relief about 1 km; MODIS NDVI and POWER precipitation

MARS_AEOLIAN.summary: Dry, barren, low-relief ground; dune fields are not identified.
